title: Private Client Paralegal
company: Michael Page Business Support - Agency - Permanent
description:
As a Private Client Paralegal in the professional services industry, you'll assist with managing client files, preparing legal documents, and ensuring the smooth handling of private client matters. Your role will help support the legal team by ensuring accuracy and efficiency in daily operations.

Client Details

This professional services firm operates within the legal industry, offering expertise and support to clients in private client matters.

Description
- Draft and prepare legal documents for private client cases.
- Maintain and manage client files, ensuring all records are accurate and up to date.
- Conduct legal research to support ongoing cases and provide relevant insights.
- Assist with the preparation of wills, trusts, and estate planning documents.
- Communicate with clients, providing updates and responding to inquiries promptly.
- Coordinate with solicitors to ensure smooth progress on cases.
- Handle administrative tasks related to the legal department.
- Ensure compliance with legal regulations and internal policies.

Profile

A successful Private Client Paralegal should have:
- A qualification or background in law or legal studies.
- Experience working within private client matters or a legal environment.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Proficiency in legal research and drafting documents.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
- A proactive approach to managing multiple tasks and deadlines.

Job Offer
- A flexible salary - dependent on the level of experience.
- A permanent contract with opportunities to develop your expertise.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Private Client Paralegal
description:
Private Client Paralegal - Inverness

A great opportunity for a Private Client Paralegal to join an established Inverness firm advising individuals and families on a range of legal matters.

What's on offer?
- Varied private client workload
- Supportive team environment
- Ongoing training and development

The role
- Draft wills and powers of attorney
- Assist with executry and estate administration
- Support guardianship applications and related matters
- Prepare legal documents and correspondence
- Liaise with clients, courts and third parties
- Manage files and key deadlines

About you
- Previous private client experience
- Knowledge of wills, executries, powers of attorney and guardianships
- Excellent client care and communication skills
- Organised and able to manage a varied workload
- Proactive and team-focused approach

The environment

You'll be joining a friendly and experienced team that provides practical and compassionate advice to clients across the Highlands, with genuine opportunities for long-term development.

If you're a Private Client Paralegal considering your next move, we would welcome a confidential chat.

How to Apply:
- Online: Apply with your updated CV via the provided link
- Contact: For immediate consideration, contact Becky Newton at G2 Legal

We look forward to hearing from you.
